name: the_component_comes_in_with_the_configuration_asked
why: Z-C21.4, finding L11-1. insert_component passed `configuration` to AddComponent5 as ExistingConfigName with UseConfigForPartReferences false, and IAssemblyDoc~AddComponent5.html says that name is «valid only if UseConfigForPartReferences = true»: the name was never used. The component came in with ConfigOption 0, swAddComponentConfigOptions_CurrentSelectedConfig, «Add a part or assembly in its last saved configuration» (swAddComponentConfigOptions_e.html), and a name the file does not have was not refused either. The library now checks the name against the configurations of the open file before inserting, passes the switch true, reads back the configuration the new component references, and takes the component out again if it is another one.
defect_caught: The plate is built with two configurations of its own, «Short» made first and «Long» made second: create_configuration activates the new one, so the file is saved with «Long» active, and «Long» is the last saved configuration. Step 1 asks for «Medium», which the file does not have: on library 0.145.0 the name is ignored, the component comes in with «Long» and the step answers success, so the refusal expected here is red. Step 2 asks for «Short», which is not the last saved one: on library 0.145.0 the component references «Long» and both configuration lines are red.
_if_it_stays_green_on_the_old_library: It does not by the guide: with the switch false the name is not used, and the last saved configuration is «Long». If step 2 went green on 0.145.0, SOLIDWORKS would be taking the name even with the switch off, and the finding would be not real: say so in Z-C21.4 before trusting this case as its proof.
_the_numbers: Base 120 x 80 x 10 inserted by the preparation (1 component). The plate is 120 x 80 x 4 and is not inserted by the preparation (`da_inserire` false): step 1 must leave 1 component, step 2 makes 2. The components in the state are sorted by name, «..._base-1» before «..._plate-1», so the plate is the second one. Four configuration names in the plate: the two of the company part template plus «Short» and «Long».

expect.why: the refusal of step 1 inserted nothing: only the base of the preparation is there
THE LINE THAT TAKES THE DEFECT: the configuration the new component references, read back after the rebuild. On 0.145.0 it is «Long», the last saved one
the same fact read from the assembly state, another path than the operation's answer
